title: Lotus 7
subtitle: How the drivetrain works
summary: A journey beneath the bodywork: from the inline-four engine to the gearbox and rear wheels.
notes: The bonnet lifts, the engine mechanism comes into view, and the transmission tunnel opens for a first and second gear comparison. An overview connects the engine, gearbox and driven wheels.
credit: Blender animation using representative engine and gearbox assets. Lotus model: Britdawgmasterfunk (CC0). Inline-four: oldtimer; gearbox: lp41 (CC BY 3.0). Rigs, materials and animation adapted. The sequence illustrates operation rather than a factory Lotus installation.

title: Flight 705
subtitle: A documentary reconstruction
summary: An aviation story told through airport scenes, route graphics and a reconstructed cockpit.
notes: The sequence establishes the aircraft and route, introduces the crew, and moves from the apron into the cockpit. Animation is presented alongside an interview excerpt.
credit: Full 3D production by Adesina Adebola: scene creation, animation, lighting, cameras and rendering. 3D documentary reconstruction with a live-action interview excerpt.

title: ProphetBots
subtitle: An animated product film
summary: A character-led product story built around a smart speaker, mobile interactions and a richly lit interior.
notes: A conversation introduces the product through close-ups, character actions and device screens. Warm materials and magenta light establish a consistent setting.
credit: Full 3D production by Adesina Adebola: scene creation, animation, lighting, cameras and rendering. Character animation, product shots and device-screen sequences.

title: Billy
subtitle: The returned ring
summary: A short story of a returned ring, told through character interactions, close-ups and changing viewpoints.
notes: A compact vertical sequence combines animated scenes, on-screen captions and a live-action ending.
credit: Full 3D production by Adesina Adebola: scene creation, animation, lighting, cameras and rendering. Animated story with Miss Wholesome branding and a live-action ending.

title: An unexpected guardian
subtitle: A short narrative scene
summary: A brief outdoor scene shifts attention from departing figures to a cat approaching a baby.
notes: A short vertical animation using character staging, changing viewpoints and an outdoor environment.
credit: Full 3D production by Adesina Adebola: scene creation, animation, lighting, cameras and rendering. A vertical animation built around character staging and an outdoor setting.
